text:
maya: Quick design check — shelf preview in the model catalog. I'm worried the performance pill (red) on the gray shelf doesn't meet contrast AA and the inline preview CTA copy 'Open' feels ambiguous. Screenshot: https://figma.mock/s/preview :eyes:

aj: Agree re contrast. Also when rows are dense the preview CTA pushes the right column and causes wrap/overflow on smaller widths. Two quick fixes: bump pill contrast + change copy, or move the CTA to the left of the row (but that changes tab order).

devon: Accessibility nit: 'Open' is vague. Prefer 'View details' or 'View model'. Also add aria-label on the preview thumbnail: `aria-label="Model preview for {model_name}"`. We should also ensure the thumbnail is focusable with clear focus ring.

lucas: FYI moving CTA left means keyboard nav & DOM order changes. That'll ripple to E2E tests and focus-trap logic in the compare modal. Rough estimate: 2 dev days to do safely + test.

tia: Copy suggestion for the perf pill: instead of '120 TPS' try 'Throughput: 120 TPS' or 'Throughput — 120 TPS' so screen readers have context. Also add a tooltip with the full phrase and an accessible label so it's read by SR.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: catalog/staging @ 2025-03-11T09:22:00Z :white_check_mark:

aj: Proposal: Option A (fast): keep CTA on right, bump pill color to meet AA, change 'Open' -> 'View details'. Option B (larger): move CTA left, update DOM order/tabindex and keyboard flows. Which to pick?

maya: Lean B for long-term but we need a quick win. Pick A for the patch: bump contrast + copy -> 'View details'. Then plan B in the next sprint with proper tabindex changes.

devon: I'll file the a11y PR for the copy + aria-labels + tooltip and add a Percy snapshot. PR will include `aria-live` for perf pill updates so SR users get metric changes.

lucas: I'll add the DOM/tabindex refactor to sprint 14. Will also update e2e tests to assert focus order.

tia: Tooltip copy: 'Estimated throughput. Values vary by sequence length.' Also ensure tooltips are keyboard focusable. Small nit: use a top-aligned tooltip on small screens to avoid covering the row.

maya: Great. Can someone drop an updated Figma with the new pill color + 'View details' copy? cc @aj @design

aj: On it — I'll update Figma and attach the link here when ready. Should have the patch-ready mock by EOD PST. :thumbsup:
